# mssql

> An asynchronous, runtime-independent, pure-Rust Tabular Data Stream (TDS) client for Microsoft SQL Server.

`mssql` is a fork of [Tiberius](https://github.com/prisma/tiberius), the TDS
client originally created by Prisma and its contributors. This fork exists
to prioritize ongoing maintenance and security updates, favoring small,
focused changes over large rewrites. It works with the Tokio, async-std, or
smol async runtimes, and is distributed under the same MIT/Apache-2.0 dual
license as Tiberius.

## Docs

- [mssql-rust.github.io](https://mssql-rust.github.io/): this site — an overview of the crate's features, install command, and links out to everything below.
- [API reference](https://docs.rs/mssql/): full rustdoc, generated from source.
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/mssql): published releases.
- [llms.json](https://mssql-rust.github.io/llms.json): machine-readable map of the crate's public exports and feature flags.
- [README](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/README.md): quickstart, configuration, encryption, authentication, bulk insert, redirects, security.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/CHANGELOG.md): release history.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute, MSRV policy, local test setup.

## Examples

- [tokio.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/tokio.rs): connect and query on the Tokio runtime.
- [async-std.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/async-std.rs): connect and query on async-std.
- [smol.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/smol.rs): connect and query on smol.
- [config_builder.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/config_builder.rs): building a Config with ConfigBuilder.
- [bulk.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/bulk.rs) and [bulk_insert_with_options.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/bulk_insert_with_options.rs): bulk insert.
- [windows_auth.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/windows_auth.rs) and [aad-auth.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/aad-auth.rs): Windows-integrated and Azure AD authentication.
- [strict_encryption.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/strict_encryption.rs), [ca_certificate_bundle.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/ca_certificate_bundle.rs), and [webpki_roots.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/webpki_roots.rs): TLS configuration variants.
- [redirects.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/redirects.rs): following server-initiated redirects.
- [in_list.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/in_list.rs): parameterized `IN (...)` queries.
- [serde_json.rs](https://github.com/mssql-rust/mssql-rust/blob/main/mssql/examples/serde_json.rs): serializing query results to JSON (`serde` feature).
